title: AstraZit Musical Work Schema
description: The canonical data contract representing the underlying musical composition (Work) in AstraZit Music OS.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the work schema (e.g. 1.0.0).

astrazit_work_id.description: Immutable internal AstraZit musical work identifier (e.g., AST-WRK-000001).

canonical_title.description: Canonical title of the musical composition.

catalog_origin.description: Distinguishes native Music OS-originated works from historical pre-existing catalog imports.

lifecycle_status.description: Lifecycle status of the musical work composition.

composition_rights.description: Canonical copyright ownership, writers, publishers, split sheets, and PRO registrations.

original_lyrics.description: Raw lyrics text as originally drafted or generated.

final_lyrics.description: Canonical verified lyrics text matching final compositions.

provenance_notes.description: Origin of lyrics, prompt references, or human author credit.

notes.description: Composition notes, arrangement notes, or historical context.

provisional_enrichments.description: Staging area for AI-generated metadata awaiting human promotion.

metadata_provenance.description: JSON Pointer to a canonical value, never staging/provenance containers. Preserve origin and revision on promotion. Pointer resolution is verified by business rules.
